source_rehash.reason: model_builder.FOOTPRINT_RANGE is now derived from DEFAULT_BUILD_CONFIG.geometry instead of restating a literal (50.0, 5000.0)
source_rehash.why_it_was_needed: the footprint ceiling was raised from 5 000 to 20 000 m2 on 2026-08-03. At 5 000 the gate excluded 123 Valencia buildings carrying 11.55 % of the city's floor area, so a city total silently stood for 87.5 % of the stock; the new ceiling brings area coverage to 98.38 %. The constant was dead code - the real gate in prepare_footprint() reads the config - so leaving it would have parked a wrong (50, 5000) two lines above the working gate
source_rehash.physics_unchanged: verified_model --verify 13/13 PASS with every gate bit-identical to the previous golden: residential area 954.800, wall U 1.409, people 73.530, heating 26.527, cooling -68.403, total site 53.680 kWh/m2. Rai's replica is 954.8 m2, far from either ceiling, so no gate could move
source_rehash.workbench_unaffected: the ceiling is a BuildConfig field the UI already exposes and validates (ConfigPanel footprint_max_m2); no adapter, scenario or LHS code path changed, and the frontend suite passes 51/51
source_rehash.no_result_invalidated: no committed run is rewritten. Past runs stay on the profile they were produced under; the new ceiling only changes which buildings a FUTURE run admits

source_rehash_history.reason: run_energyplus gained an optional epw_path argument so a scenario weather file reaches EnergyPlus itself
source_rehash_history.why_it_was_needed: EnergyPlus's --weather overrides the model, so mb.set_weather_file() alone changed nothing: measured 2026-07-30, an EPW with every hour +5 K and the city renamed gave a byte-identical result while eplusout.eio named VALENCIA and the OSM named TESTCITY
source_rehash_history.physics_unchanged: epw_path defaults to None -> mb.EPW_FILE, i.e. the previous behaviour; pilot regression 11.21 / 16.60 kWh/m2 QA ALL PASSED, verified_model --verify 13/13 with every gate bit-identical to the previous golden
source_rehash_history.workbench_unaffected: simulation_adapter.py sets runner.mb.EPW_FILE around the call; with epw_path unset the fallback is still mb.EPW_FILE, so Part B/G behave exactly as before
source_rehash_history.no_result_invalidated: the project has only ever held one EPW (ESP_Valencia.082840_IWEC.epw), so no recorded run was ever produced through the broken --epw path
